root.name: Bishop's Opening: Four Pawns Gambit
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 Bc5 3. b4 Bxb4 4. f4 exf4 5. Nf3 Be7 6. d4 Bh4+ 7. g3 fxg3 8. O-O gxh2+ 9. Kh1

overview: In the McDonnell Gambit White gives b4 and f4 pawns and after ...Bh4+ g3 fxg3 the h2 pawn is lost too, leaving the king exposed on h1. White hopes to attack with the open f-file and pieces, but Black can keep the material. Sharp, double-edged, and probably dubious for White.

white_ideas.idea: Use the open f-file and the central d4/e4 pawns
Open lines with Bxf7 or Qd3

black_ideas.idea: Keep the extra material and hold the king
Trade queens or counterattack on the kingside

typical_structures.structure: Open position with White pawn count much lower than Black

character.notes: Mutual attacks with an exposed king.

character.reason: Several pawns given and an exposed king.

soundness.reason: Black should be able to keep the extra material.

plans.reason: White plays for an attack on the open f-file.
